data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-r-n', meaning 'moon'. In Islamic culture, the moon is a symbol of guidance and spiritual enlightenment. Mehreenah carries the essence of radiant light, illuminating the path for those who seek guidance. The name Mehreenah carries the meaning “Moonlight, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehreenah usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
